name: Psychiatry and Behavioral Sciences Minor
intro: The Psychiatry and Behavioral Sciences minor offers students the ability to explore knowledge, concepts and research in the areas of psychiatry and behavioral health, providing a solid foundation of these salient topics for students interested in pursuing professions within the healthcare field or applying these concepts more broadly in professional settings.
